summary: Implemented patch-level transforms and optional coordinate outputs in GridPatchDataset (monai/data/grid_dataset.py). Added `transform` (applied to the tuple of patches per grid position) and `with_coordinates` (default False; when True yields (patches, coordinates) with each array's patch start index). Added TestGridPatchDataset tests in tests/test_patch_dataset.py. Tests were not run, per instructions; nothing was committed. Open choice: with_coordinates defaults to False to preserve existing output, though the checklist marks this as breaking; flip the default if upstream behavior is wanted.
